findings.description: The PostgreSQL migration explicitly replaces legacy RPC overloads while preserving caller defaults, security context, and descending read order.
findings.resolution: Maintain the planned migration structure and RPC alignment tests.

findings.description: The plan cleanly splits supervisor state along the derivable and non-derivable boundary.
findings.resolution: Preserve the derivable/non-derivable seam and dedicated mirror schema.

findings.description: Supervisor-only retrieval is consistently propagated across every named layer, preventing ordinary handoffs from masking supervisor state.
The fallback rehydration mechanism uses the tracked mirror and fresh derivation when the coordinator is unreachable.
findings.resolution: Keep the planned offline fallback sequence intact.

findings.description: The builder plan pins deterministic sorting, timestamp injection for byte-stable tests, and idempotent mirror writes.
findings.resolution: Enforce deterministic sorting and timestamp parameterization in unit tests.

findings.description: Boundary object validation and the inner schema prevent malformed supervisor records without coupling SQL to inner versions.
Fingerprint exclusion and unchanged mirror no-ops prevent self-triggering supervisor-cycle churn.
findings.resolution: Exclude mirror paths from fingerprint calculations.

findings.description: A single supervisor_record JSONB key avoids parameter proliferation while allowing inner versioning.
